summary: 36-year-old Telluride man mountain biking with two friends fell ~200 ft down a steep slope on Calico Trail west of Rico; packaged in litter and wheeled 1.5 miles to trailhead and waiting ambulance.
responding_agency: Dolores County SAR, San Miguel County SAR, Rico Fire Department
notes: San Miguel County SAR mutual aid to Dolores County; mission took ~5.5 hrs; companions (an EMT and a Wilderness First Responder) provided initial care and activated SAR via satellite texting.
